title: From Tiny Child to Gray Hair
story: My Hope Since I Was Little
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A song-writer had grown so old,
He looked back on his years,
And saw that God was with him through
The laughter and the tears.

[Chorus]
Heavenly Father's been my hope
Since I was very small,
He's cared for me my whole life long,
He'll never leave at all.

[Verse 2]
'From when I was a tiny child,
Until my hair turned gray,
You never left my side,' he sang,
'You've been with me each day.'

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, my little one,
God loved you from the start,
He'll walk with you when you are big,
And always hold your heart.

[Chorus]
mood: Remembering music. A slow, patient sway like an old rocking chair moving with the weight of many years, matching a story of looking back on a whole life with God beside. The pulse is warm and unhurried, with a lift of wonder under the second verse. By the last verse it eases lower and slower, the chair barely moving as the child drifts off.
